build_task_beam_balancing: build a PHYRE task that creates a beam balancing puzzle with a fulcrum, beam, and ball
create_static_ball_fulcrum: create a static ball object as a fulcrum using C.add with scale and position
create_dynamic_bar_beam: create a dynamic bar object as a beam using C.add with center_x and bottom positioning
create_dynamic_ball_target: create a dynamic ball object positioned on the beam using C.add with left and bottom
update_task_spatial_relationship: update the task success condition using C.update_task with body1, body2, and ABOVE relationship
